symptom: my pushbutton reads random 0/1 values when not pressed. It's wired between BCM GPIO2 and GND (no external pull-up resistor). I expected it to read 1 when not pressed.

files.btn.py:
from gpiozero import Button
from signal import pause
# Button wired BCM2 -> GND, no external pull-up.
btn = Button(2)
pause()

gold.diagnosis: The button has no external pull-up and the internal pull is not enabled, so the pin floats and reads randomly. gpiozero Button enables the internal pull-up by default (pull_up=True), so Button(2) should already pull the pin high when not pressed. If the wiring needs the internal pull explicitly, pass Button(2, pull_up=True); the key point is the pin must not float.
